# Lob Trust & Security Center

At Lob, we recognize that secure and compliant mail operations are critical to your business. Whether you’re streamlining customer communications, automating transactional mail, or leveraging intelligent mail for data-driven campaigns, we are committed to protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of your data.

Please see [our subprocessor page](https://www.lob.com/subprocessors) Opens in new tab for information regarding Lob's third party sub-processors.

[security@lob.com](mailto:security@lob.com)

[Privacy Policy](https://www.lob.com/privacy) Opens in new tab

We align our information security program with industry best practices and regularly validate the effectiveness of our program and security controls through rigorous third-party security assessments and compliance audits.

### **Industry-Leading Security & Compliance**

- **SOC 2 Type 2 Compliance** – We complete an annual audit against all five Trust Services Criteria (security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy) to demonstrate our commitment to security and compliance.
- **Privacy & Regulatory Alignment** – Our security and data protection practices are designed to support compliance with applicable regulations, including HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA, helping customers meet their legal and contractual obligations. For organizations handling protected health information (PHI), we also offer dedicated HIPAA-compliant processes and facilities, provide a Business Associate Agreement (BAA), and undergo an annual HIPAA Privacy audit.
- **Enterprise-Grade Infrastructure** – Our platform is powered by AWS data centers in the U.S., which maintain industry-leading security, redundancy, and compliance certifications.
- **Third-Party Penetration Testing** – We engage independent security firms for annual penetration testing to assess and strengthen our security posture.
- **Secure and Seamless Access** – We support Single Sign-On (SSO) and SAML integration to enhance secure authentication for our platform.
- **Trusted Partner Network** – Our print and delivery partners must meet strict security and compliance requirements, helping to maintain strong data protections throughout the entire mailing lifecycle.

Lob is redefining mail by making it as simple and scalable as email. With security embedded in every aspect of our intelligent mail platform, we empower our customers to confidently automate their print and mail workflows while meeting their compliance and operational requirements.

See Lob's [subprocessor page](https://www.lob.com/subprocessors) Opens in new tab for more information regarding Lob's subprocessors.

- Production environment access restricted

- Unique account authentication enforced
